thread.title: Snap +6.1%; The Information suggests stake sale could happen - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Jason Aycock
title: Snap +6.1%; The Information suggests stake sale could happen - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Snap (NYSE: SNAP ) is making a sharp move higher today, up 6.1% and at its highest point in over a month, and pressing for its fourth straight day of gains.
Key news today is a suggestion from The Information about how the company can deal with a heavy cash burn: It's spend $1.1B over five quarters and has about $1.8B left to tap.
The article speculates that Snap could sell a stake for cash , perhaps to Tencent ( OTCPK:TCEHY ), which already holds a stake in the company.
But the article suggests the company could even head to Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ), Amazon.com (NASDAQ: AMZN ) or Google ( GOOG , GOOGL ), and cites a May 1 shelf registration as evidence that it could happen.
